g1.flow: Same words in both surahs: fī jannatin ʿāliyah. Al-Ḥāqqah reaches it from one person: 'So he will be in a pleasant life'. Al-Ghāshiyah reaches it from 'with their effort satisfied'. Hook: Al-Ḥāqqah's garden comes after 'he', and its next ayah shows fruit hanging near; Al-Ghāshiyah's garden comes after 'their effort', and next they hear no unsuitable speech.

cues.69:22: After 'he will be in a pleasant life'; next, its fruit hangs near to pick.
cues.88:10: After 'with their effort satisfied'; next, they hear no unsuitable speech there.
